mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, prk_center_id, memo, created_at, updated_at FROM FAVORITE_PARKING WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT fp.id, fp.user_id, fp.prk_center_id, fp.memo, fp.created_at, fp.updated_at, pi.prk_plce_nm, pi.prk_plce_adres, pi.prk_cmprt_co FROM FAVORITE_PARKING fp LEFT JOIN PARKING_INFO pi ON fp.prk_center_id = pi.prk_center_id WHERE fp.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY fp.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FAVORITE_PARKING (user_id, prk_center_id, memo, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{prkCenterId}, #{memo}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM FAVORITE_PARKING WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND prk_center_id = #{prkCenterId}
